reason: Two concurrent continuations mutated the same primary Blender project under the same claim/branch while fleet registry still reported reserved/ack:null. R12/R13 were independently verified and accepted; further multi-writer mutation is prohibited.
mutation_rules: Do not mutate the primary remote while ops/fleet/registry.json reports this claim reserved or ack:null.
After registry becomes active, exactly one writer session owns the primary project for a wave.
A writer must read current branch, claim, this fence, current project revision/scene sequence and ensure no active operation immediately before mutation.
A second agent must use a separate project plus atomic subclaim or remain read-only; it must not share this primary writer epoch.
Every accepted mutation must persist generator/receipt/handoff before the next writer epoch is handed off.
Unexpected revision advancement during a read-only operation is a concurrency incident and freezes mutation until reconciled.
truth: Cooperative fence. It does not create a provider-level ACL; compliance depends on agents reading repository governance.
